name: Out-of-Service Room Protection
natural_language: A room with an active out-of-service period must not have an arriving reservation.
restricted_language: every room collecting occupancy by room.number to occupancy.room_number where room.closed_from exists must not have occupancy.from within room.closed_from to room.closed_to and room.closed_from within occupancy.from to occupancy.to showing occupancy.reservation_id and reservation.arrival_date and stay.room_number and reservation.status

population.description: Rooms that currently have a closed window set; then reservations arriving inside that window.

then: GetReservationKey with ArrivalDate spanning the union of closed windows
minihotel.call_cost: O(1) - starts from the room side, which is the smaller set

demopms.call_cost: O(1) - two bulk calls. This provider nests each occupancy segment inside its room, but it still takes a second call to get them: the room master carries configuration, the occupancy call carries a window

references.note: Every occupancy segment on this room. A collection, not a lookup: one room has many segments, and this control starts from the room side.

predicates.note: A segment that begins inside the closed window. Version 2 placed occupancy.reservation_id here - a reservation id between two dates, which compared as strings put every real id outside every window, so the room PASSed (issue #87). Mode none: the room FAILs if EITHER predicate holds, which together is 'a segment overlaps the window', boundaries inclusive.

A window that begins during a segment - a guest already in the room when it closes, which the first predicate misses. Both read occupancy, a collection, and the evaluator does not yet judge every record of one (#87's option 2), so until it does a room in scope is UNKNOWN, never a PASS read from its first segment.

required_evidence.note: shown beside the verdict: which reservation the segment belongs to
the segment's first night, against the closed window
the segment's end, so a window opening during a stay is seen too
the key this control's occupancy collection joins on
the far side of that join

execution.rationale: Type C. The doc's own periodic-state example. The trigger is a room being blocked, and MiniHotel emits no event for that - only reservation events exist.

freshness_requirement.rationale: Same guest-facing urgency as 1d; the doc rates OOO conflicts high-urgency.

unknown_conditions.when: a room in scope - one with a closed window
unknown_conditions.reason: the assertion reads the room's occupancy segments, a collection, and the evaluator does not yet judge every record of a collection (issue #87, option 2). Until it does, every room with a closed window is UNKNOWN rather than judged by its first segment

unknown_conditions.when: a room is blocked through a mechanism other than rm_clsdt1/rm_clsdt2
unknown_conditions.reason: MiniHotel also defines a reservation status 'CLOSE' (Closed Room); it is unconfirmed which mechanism a property actually uses

caveats: Shares the unproven closed-date mechanism with 1d and 13. Confirming it on one real property moves all three controls at once.
